title: still present since round 4: vacancy/status mutations return Ok unconditionally — nonexistent ids report success
evidence: demo_store.gleam:1245 (archive_vacancy): '#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(vacancy_id))' — same at 1259 (restore_vacancy) and 1273 (close_vacancy); 1356 (change_status): '#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(slug))'; 1493 (refcheck_action_with_contact): '#(DemoStore(..store, vacancies: updated), Ok(call_id))'; 1547 (mark_notification_read): '#(DemoStore(..store, notifications: updated), Ok(notification_id))'. No find/membership check precedes any return; the list.map no-ops on unknown ids.
detail: The error channel stays dead: a stale/unknown vacancy, application, call, or notification id mutates nothing yet reports success — the demo UI toasts success for no-ops.
recommended_fix: list.find the target first and propagate Error like update_vacancy/publish_vacancy already do.

title: still present since round 4: create_vacancy derives ids from an 8-char slug with no uniqueness check
detail: Duplicate demo vacancy ids: detail lookups resolve the first row only, archive/close map over both, and the dashboard shows two cards sharing one identity.
recommended_fix: Check the derived id against store.vacancies and append a counter on collision.

title: still present since round 4: send_reminder / remind_applicant / send_bulk_invite mutate nothing and return canned counts
detail: Reminder state (reminded/followed_up on the awaiting list) never persists — repeated reminders always report the same canned (2,1)/(1,0) counts, contradicting the derived remindable_count.
recommended_fix: Thread the store back to the model like the other mutations and derive counts from the awaiting pool.

title: still present since round 4: mark_opened doc claims idempotent Submitted->UnderReview but applies to any status
detail: A viewed, shortlisted, approved, or rejected application re-opens to UnderReview, and each open appends another status_auto_changed audit row — not idempotent as documented.
recommended_fix: Guard on current status == Submitted (no-op otherwise), or correct the doc.

title: still present since round 4 (partial): demo dispatch arms remain unpinned — refcheck (UserChoseRefcheckAction/UserConfirmedRefcheckAction/UserSavedRefcheckEdit), single mark-read, report download, mark-opened threading, edit deep-link boot (get_for_edit)
evidence: demo_flow_test dispatch pins added at r5 cover only the four claimed arms: 'pub fn demo_load_more_applications_pins_loading_test' (:733), 'pub fn demo_scoring_status_arm_dispatch_test' (:740), 'pub fn demo_comparison_arm_pins_loading_test' (:770), 'pub fn demo_awaiting_section_pins_loading_test' (:780). Grep of client/test/demo/*.gleam for 'UserChoseRefcheckAction|UserConfirmedRefcheckAction|UserSavedRefcheckEdit|UserClickedDownloadReport|UserClickedNotification(' matches nothing; demo_refcheck_actions_mutate_store_test (:469) and demo_substitute_applies_typed_contact_test (:503) call demo_store directly, not client.update.
detail: Reverting the store threading in demo_update's refcheck arms, download arm, single mark-read, or mark-opened threading stays green — the W13 fold pinned only load-more/comparison/awaiting/scoring.
recommended_fix: Drive the remaining arms through client.update from a demo model, one pin per arm (the existing r3-W2 pattern).

title: still present since round 4: demo_not_in_demo_toast diverges from add_toast's id convention — ids can collide
evidence: demo_not_in_demo_toast: '  let toast_id = model.next_toast_id + 1' then 'next_toast_id: toast_id'. add_toast (client.gleam): '  let id = model.next_toast_id' ... '#(Model(..model, toasts: capped_toasts, next_toast_id: id + 1), dismiss_eff)'. From next_toast_id=0: a demo toast takes id 1 (next stays 1), then the next add_toast also takes id 1.
detail: Two live toasts share an id; AppDismissToast filters by id and dismisses both (or the wrong one), and the auto-dismiss timers double-fire.
recommended_fix: Use add_toast's convention (id = next_toast_id, then +1) or route through add_toast itself.

title: still present since round 4: zero-caller export demo_store.notifications shipped
detail: Unused public surface on the demo store invites drift with notifications_unread.

title: still present since round 4: status_from_slug silently coerces unknown slugs to Submitted
detail: A typo'd or novel status slug (e.g. from a future shared enum extension) regresses an application to Submitted in the demo instead of erroring.
recommended_fix: Return Result and propagate Error for unknown slugs (change_status already has an error channel).

title: still present since round 4: fetch_leaderboard_page ignores its page parameter
detail: Load-more in the demo re-delivers page 1's full list every time; ApiReturnedLeaderboardPage treats it as a new page append.
recommended_fix: Slice the entry list by page (page size parity with the real API) or document the single-page demo list.

title: still present since round 4: store_of's None fallback re-seeds on every call without writing back to the model
detail: If demo_store were ever None with demo_mode True, every dispatch re-seeds a fresh store and all demo mutations silently no-persist across calls.
recommended_fix: Thread the fallback seed into the returned Model (or assert-and-exit demo mode) so the invariant is self-healing.

title: still present since round 4: for_edit reports updated_at: vac.created_at and update_vacancy never bumps timestamps
evidence: for_edit: '    updated_at: vac.created_at,' — update_vacancy rebuilds Vacancy(..old, property_name: payload.property_name, ...) without touching created_at/closes_at or any updated_at field.
detail: The demo edit page always shows the creation date as last-updated, even after edits — diverges from the real surface it mirrors.
recommended_fix: Bump a demo updated_at on update_vacancy/publish and report it in for_edit.

title: still present since round 4: demo_update header claims the CI lint 'bans network imports from demo/' while the fetch grep exempts the whole demo_api.gleam file
detail: A new gleam/fetch import anywhere in demo_api.gleam passes CI; the header's blanket claim oversells the ban's granularity.
recommended_fix: Scope the exemption to the download function (e.g. line-window or a sentinel comment the grep anchors on) and soften the header claim.

title: new (same class as the r4 change_status trigger note): demo bulk_reject hardcodes audit trigger 'leaderboard_select' — the sweep-nudge path's trigger is discarded
evidence:
demo_store.bulk_reject audit entry: 'details: Some("{\"trigger\":\"leaderboard_select\"}"),' — unconditional. demo_api: 'pub fn bulk_reject_applications(
  store: DemoStore,
  vacancy_id: String,
  ids: List(String),
  _trigger: String,
  _csrf_token: String,' with body 'let #(next, count) = demo_store.bulk_reject(store, vacancy_id, ids)' — _trigger never passed down. demo_update sweep-nudge arm passes '"sweep_nudge",'.
detail: A sweep-nudge bulk reject writes trigger 'leaderboard_select' in the demo audit trail — exactly the hardcoded-trigger class the r4 change_status fix addressed.
recommended_fix: Pass the trigger through to demo_store.bulk_reject and write it in the audit details.

title: still present since round 4 (download_timeout half): download_timeout duplicated between client.gleam and demo_update.gleam
evidence:
client.gleam:6923: 'fn download_timeout(analysis_id: String, delay_ms: Int) -> Effect(Msg) {'. demo_update.gleam:860: 'fn download_timeout(id: String) -> Effect(Msg) {' with doc '/// 90s download timeout — mirrors client.gleam's `download_timeout` so a
/// slow static asset (unlikely) still surfaces the brand-voice toast.' (the store_of half of the r4 note is fixed — client.gleam's demo_store_of now delegates to demo_update.store_of).
detail: Two parallel timeout helpers for the same report-download lifecycle can drift (different signatures already: fixed 90s vs parameterised delay).
recommended_fix: Export one download_timeout from demo_update (or a shared helper) and have client.gleam call it.
